# gpac_4006: submission package (generated by `leakproof package`; nothing has been posted)

> **Verified, needs human review.** Neither project tests nor a fuzz harness ran, so the gate saw only the reproducer (and any generated or adversary inputs). Read the diff before sending.

Issue: https://github.com/gpac/gpac/issues/4006
Defect: heap-buffer-overflow in `gf_fopen_ex` (`src/utils/os_file.c:1721`). Gate verdict: **verified**; evidence: verified, needs human review.

## The patch

`0001-isomedia-nul-terminate-an-in-memory-meta-item-full-path.patch` (this directory), `git format-patch` form: apply with `git am 0001-isomedia-nul-terminate-an-in-memory-meta-item-full-path.patch`. The
author is `<your git identity>` unless `--author` was given; fix it with
`git commit --amend --reset-author`.

```diff
diff --git a/src/isomedia/meta.c b/src/isomedia/meta.c
--- a/src/isomedia/meta.c
+++ b/src/isomedia/meta.c
@@ -1769,10 +1769,11 @@
 		/*store full path for info*/
 		else if (!location_entry->data_reference_index) {
 			if (data) {
-				infe->full_path = (char *)gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * data_len);
+				infe->full_path = (char *)gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * (data_len + 1));
 				if (!infe->full_path) return GF_OUT_OF_MEM;
 
 				memcpy(infe->full_path, data, sizeof(char) * data_len);
+				infe->full_path[data_len] = '\0';
 				infe->data_len = data_len;
 			}
 			else if (resource_path) {
```

## Planner's analysis (written before the fix; check it against the diff)

Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote this root-cause analysis before any patch existed. It can describe a
different mechanism than the one the final diff fixes, so it is here for the reviewer and never
in the commit message.

> In meta.c, infe->full_path is allocated with exactly data_len bytes and memcpy copies data_len bytes without ensuring null termination. When gf_fopen later reads this path, it reads past the allocation looking for a null terminator, causing heap-buffer-overflow.

## Commit message (in the patch)

```
os_file: fix heap-buffer-overflow in gf_fopen_ex()

AddressSanitizer reports a heap-buffer-overflow in gf_fopen_ex()
(src/utils/os_file.c:1721).

The change, in meta.c:

    -				infe->full_path = (char *)gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * data_len);
    +				infe->full_path = (char *)gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * (data_len + 1));
    +				infe->full_path[data_len] = '\0';

Fixes #4006.
```
